title: How to Obtain Console Middleware for the Social SDK
body:

Introduction

To obtain console binaries for the Discord Social SDK, you'll need proper credentials and must complete our console middleware request process. Start by requesting the Discord Social SDK middleware through your console's developer portal.

Discord Social SDK for PlayStation™

Step 1. Sign in to your PlayStation™ Partners account.

Step 2. Select ‘Discord Social SDK’ from the Tools & Middleware directory to confirm developer status.

After completing the request, proceed to the "What Next?" section below.

Discord Social SDK for Xbox

Step 1. Sign in to your Xbox Game Dev Portal account.

Step 2. Select ‘Discord Social SDK’ from the Middleware Partner dropdown here

Step 3. Click 'Submit Request'.

After completing the request, proceed to the "What Next?" section below.

What Next?

After the applicable console platform contacts us about your request, we may contact you at the email address associated with your console developer portal account with a form link to gather more information from you.

We may share this information with the console platform. Please note that you are not required to share confidential information about your game--providing temporary names, franchise names, or codenames will suffice where titles are requested.

Once your form submission has been reviewed, if approved, we'll set up your application with the appropriate permissions to access the console binaries and notify you directly.

Need more help? Join our Discord Developers server to connect with other developers in the #social-sdk-dev-help channel or reach out to our support team here!
